methodology.baseline: Current generated shared Auto64 captured once per scope, then current per-asset/full-GIF subset selection. New-centroid colors explicitly break shared target membership; exact subset-swaps preserve it.
methodology.objective: Mean sum-of-three-channel squared distance, encodedRGB or Oklab, unweighted by alpha; frame-delay weighted; Cut128/Keep1 eligibility.
methodology.strict: Every original visible source RGB nearest error must not increase at all; no epsilon. Exact baseline/source colors must remain literal palette members. Aggregate improvement must exceed 1e-12*max(1,baselineMean).
methodology.rare: Source RGB duration mass <=1% of item visible mass cannot worsen; exact baseline/source colors retained. Larger groups may worsen.
methodology.performance: Research candidate measures include histogram, all3guard variants, fitting/swaps and cooperative scheduler; exclude source decode, productionAuto/cap caches, worker transfer/UI. Not shipping latency.
methodology.blockMetric: Nonoverlapping4x4 windows with all source pixels eligible; alpha-weighted linearRGB average mapped toOklab. Excludes transparent-boundary windows and reports coverage. Point/tone metrics are not semantic quality.
methodology.overflow: Morethan16384source RGBs conservatively retains baseline and reports null/incomplete research objective.

invariants.name: Production PNG encode / independent Sharp decode
